five_second.sells: Online drawing/art courses built around 'Neurographica' and chakra/manifesting spiritual themes
five_second.for_whom: people into mindfulness, spiritual healing, and calming creative hobbies
five_second.price_guess: no price visible on the first screen at all; my gut guess before scrolling would have been $30-50 for an online course

features_used.moment: Opened the menu right away since the homepage had no obvious shop link, and found Courses there.
Scrolled through the full Featured Courses list looking for something called Neurographica, but none of the six course names showed a price.

features_used.feature: course sales page (Tangle with Ann / Zendala)
features_used.moment: Read the whole calming description but still no price, only a Join Now button, so I had to click further to find out what it cost.
The price only appeared once I reached the actual checkout page, and for this course it was $99, way over my $70 budget.
Out of habit I typed WELCOME10 and hit Apply; it correctly told me the coupon was invalid since no code was ever actually advertised on the site.
Found a page literally titled '7 Chakras NeuroGraphica Drawing Masterclasses' which matched the word I half-remembered from the TikTok video.
This checkout clearly showed $59.00 USD, and back on the sales page I saw it was discounted from a crossed-out $159.99, which felt like a real deal under my budget.
Checked the menu's 'Our Graduates' link looking for proof real people took courses here, and found a directory of 28 named facilitators with their own websites and social links.
Filled in my email and name and saw the rest of the form was just card number, expiration, CVC, country and zip, plus an unchecked newsletter box - nothing excessive.

features_looked_for_but_missing: a visible price on the course catalog list or on each course's own sales page, instead of only at checkout
student reviews, testimonials, or star ratings on the 7 Chakras Neurographica course page itself
a short preview video or sample drawing to see what the course actually teaches before paying
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: Finding the '7 Chakras Neurographica Drawing Masterclasses' page, which literally had the word I remembered from the TikTok video, with a clear $59 price at checkout and a crossed-out higher price showing a real discount.
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: Prices were hidden from every course listing and sales page - I had to click all the way to checkout to see a number, and the first course I checked that way turned out to be $99, well over my $70 budget.

friction.moment: The /store course catalog listed six courses with descriptions but zero prices anywhere.
Clicked Join Now on the Zendala course and only found out it was $99 (over budget) after reaching the checkout page, three screens in.
No testimonials, reviews, or student count on the 7 Chakras Neurographica sales page itself, even though the course I actually wanted lived there.
Tried my usual promo code habit (WELCOME10) at checkout and it was rejected as invalid, though to be fair no discount was ever advertised on the site.

delight.moment: Landing on a page literally titled '7 Chakras NeuroGraphica Drawing Masterclasses' - the exact word I half-remembered from the TikTok video.
Seeing $59.00 clearly on the checkout page, comfortably under my $70 budget, with a crossed-out $159.99 showing a real discount.
The checkout form itself was refreshingly simple - email, name, and standard card fields, nothing extra demanded.

what_earned_it: a directory of 28 real, named graduates/facilitators with their own personal websites and social links
checkout only asked for card, email, and name - nothing excessive that would make me bail
a clearly displayed final price with a secure/SSL payment note before I'd need to enter card details
trust.what_it_would_take: Show the price directly on each course's own sales page instead of hiding it until checkout, and add a couple of real testimonials or before/after examples specific to the actual drawing course, not just the advanced certification graduates.

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's a small site called Neuro Art School for calming chakra and manifesting drawing courses - the neurographica one I wanted ended up being $59, but be warned the prices are hidden until you get all the way to checkout and one course I looked at first was actually $99.
